Tap_Type_and_Enter.name: Tap_Type_and_Enter
Tap_Type_and_Enter.description: Tap an input box at position (x, y), Type the "text", and then perform the Enter operation. Very useful for searching and sending messages!
Tap_Type_and_Enter.precondition: There is a text input box on the screen with no previously entered content.

Open_App_Drawer.name: Open_App_Drawer
Open_App_Drawer.description: Open the App Drawer to find Apps.

Enable_Battery_Percentage.name: Enable_Battery_Percentage
Enable_Battery_Percentage.description: Search for the 'Battery' settings and enable the 'Battery percentage' option to display the battery percentage in the status bar.
Enable_Battery_Percentage.precondition: The 'Settings' app is open, and the search bar is visible on the screen.
